items.readable_text:
Content:
If we're given two points, we can find the line of reflection that maps one point onto another by finding the perpendicular bisector of the segment joining the two points.

Content:
For example, suppose that the line [MATH: l] reflects the point [MATH: A] onto [MATH: A'] below. How can we find the equation of [MATH: l?]

Graphic:
[IMG: /graphics/9b03e0a857d8af4c6b556144cf87b0ba]

Content:
The line [MATH: l] is the perpendicular bisector of the line segment [MATH: \overline{AA'}.] So, the line of reflection is [MATH: y=-1.]

Graphic:
